name: vibe-fixer-a11y
description: Free Claude skill: review a Shopify theme Liquid file for accessibility problems and get suggested fixes.

plugins.name: shopify-theme-accessibility-review
plugins.description: Reviews one Shopify theme Liquid file (section, snippet or block) for form labels, image alt text, names for icon-only links and buttons, keyboard focus, and colour contrast where the colours are in the file, and suggests a fix for each.
